children: Nvidia is the largest contributor of open models and data to Hugging Face, Chief Executive Jensen Huang says in a blog post. Nvidia, which is buying Hugging Face for roughly $13 billion, has released upwards of 500 models and 250 open datasets on the platform. "NVIDIA has been committed to open weight models for years, demonstrated by multiyear investments and major contributions to open source platforms, including Hugging Face," Huang writes. "NVIDIA has said that open models, data and tools broaden access to AI, and it has contributed hundreds of open models and datasets to Hugging Face as part of that effort."  (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
